edges.reason: transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
_transfer derives 'from' from _msgSender() when invoked by transfer().
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance accounting.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
amount argument drives all transfer math and cap checks in _transfer.
from argument used for zero-address, bot and pair checks.
to argument used for zero-address, exclusion and cooldown checks.
_transfer delegates final token movement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform the reflection transfer.
_transferStandard distributes the team fee through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee through _reflectFee.
_getValues supplies rAmount/rTransferAmount/rFee and t-values to _transferStandard.
_getRate supplies currentRate used by _getValues.
_getCurrentSupply supplies rSupply and tSupply to _getRate.
_tTotal is read as the tSupply inside _getCurrentSupply.
_rTotal is read as the rSupply inside _getCurrentSupply.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with tokenAmount, path and block.timestamp deadline.
uniswapV2Router address and WETH() are used to build and execute the swap.
sendETHToFee performs native transfers of the contract ETH balance.
_teamAddress is the destination of half of the ETH amount.
_marketingFunds is the destination of half of the ETH amount.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the cached contract token balance.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee with address(this).balance.
_maxTxAmount is enforced by require(amount <= _maxTxAmount).
bots mapping is checked to block blacklisted senders and receivers.
cooldown mapping is read against and written from block.timestamp.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether takeFee remains true.
_maxTxAmount = _tTotal.mul(maxTxPercent).div(10**2) performs scaled multiplication.
Attacker-uncontrolled owner input maxTxPercent feeds unscaled arithmetic on the total supply.
Each bots_ element is written into the bots mapping inside the loop.
notbot key cleared in the bots mapping.
onoff is written to cooldownEnabled.
tokenAmount is passed as amountIn to the router swap call.
amount is divided by two and pushed to both recipients.
account indexes _rOwned before reflection conversion.
rAmount is divided by the current rate to obtain the token balance.
_takeTeam credits rTeam into _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the amount into _allowances[owner][spender].
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract token and ETH balances.
openTrading calls the factory createPair to register the trading pair.
openTrading approves the router with type(uint256).max on the pair token.
uniswapV2Pair address is the target of the unlimited approve.
uniswapV2Router is assigned the hardcoded router instance in openTrading.
_taxFee is supplied as the taxFee argument to _getValues.
_teamFee is supplied as the team fee argument to _getValues.
transfer() calls _transfer and returns true.
transferFrom() calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
approve() calls the private _approve helper.
manualswap() calls swapTokensForEth directly.
manualsend() calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard between remove/restore fee calls.
_transfer ends its fee logic by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transferStandard destructures the tuple returned by _getValues.
The external router swap executes before _transfer completes, so the contract receive()/fallback and ETH-sending callbacks can reenter the transfer flow.
Native ETH transfers to the team and marketing addresses invoke their receive() and can reenter while _transfer state is not yet settled.
addLiquidityETH external call returns token/ETH/liquidity values back into openTrading.
createPair external call returns the resulting pair address into openTrading.
manualswap authorization relies solely on require(_msgSender() == _teamAddress).
manualsend authorization relies solely on require(_msgSender() == _teamAddress).
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
setBots is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
delBot is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
setMaxTxPercent is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
_transfer requires _msgSender() == uniswapV2Router or uniswapV2Pair while cooldownEnabled, an origin-based gate.
require(cooldown[to] < block.timestamp) and cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 10 seconds make transfer gating timestamp dependent.
deadline = block.timestamp is passed to swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
deadline = block.timestamp is passed to addLiquidityETH in openTrading.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a function-scoped argument that only exists to parameterize _transfer.
to is a function-scoped argument that only exists to parameterize _transfer.
amount is a function-scoped argument consumed entirely inside _transfer.
recipient belongs only to the public transfer wrapper.
amount belongs only to the public transfer wrapper.
account is the sole lookup key of the balanceOf view.
rAmount is the sole conversion input of tokenFromReflection.
tokenAmount parameterizes the internal swap executed by swapTokensForEth.
amount is the ETH value split by sendETHToFee.
bots_ is the iteration source of the blacklist write loop in setBots.
notbot is the single mapping key cleared by delBot.
maxTxPercent is the arithmetic input recomputing _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent.
onoff is the single boolean written by setCooldownEnabled.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary cache inside _transfer feeding swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a temporary cache inside _transfer feeding sendETHToFee.
path is constructed and consumed entirely inside swapTokensForEth.
takeFee is the temporary flag deciding fee removal in _tokenTransfer.
currentRate is the transient rate value produced by _getRate and its callers.
_uniswapV2Router is a temporary router handle used only within openTrading.
